scope: Deliberately selected single-file illustration of direct parser output. Not a frozen benchmark, MCP-session measurement, or whole-agent token-savings estimate.
selection_reason: Atlas session.py is an implementation-heavy file whose API surface and hidden correctness checks illustrate both compression and information loss.

measurements.structured_response_note: Raw parser JSON contains the complete skeleton text plus chunk text and spans; it is preserved exactly. This is not the MCP context manifest, which avoids duplicated chunk source.

omitted_debugging_examples.source_excerpt: if after != manifest or after_configs != configs:
omitted_debugging_examples.why_body_read_is_needed: A signature alone cannot show the second manifest comparison that rejects changes during source capture.
The ownership check deciding whether cancellation may terminate the active worker is omitted.
The fallback kill/join behavior needed to debug worker shutdown is omitted.

limits: Measures one deliberately selected file, not a representative repository sample.
Plain text counts exclude MCP schemas, call arguments, pagination, coverage wrappers, history, model reasoning and follow-up reads.
The source and skeleton carry different information; a smaller skeleton does not establish lower cost at equal task accuracy.
cl100k_base is a specific tokenizer, not a universal token count for every MCP client/model.
No embedding model, repository graph/index, MCP worker or code task was started.
